business_delta: Against each accepted two-aircraft formation parent, MissionType.NOS and MNOS change 2 to 1 and a second OperationProfile row schedules the same one-aircraft mission at 28.5 after the 28.0 first mission; description labels provenance. This creates half-hour staggered crew-dependent preparation on the retained two-crew pool and 23-25/26-28 shift windows. Between the two child inputs, the sole business difference is ShiftResource.MAXUT unset versus 1.0 hour per crew; descriptions differ for provenance.
pre_run_hypothesis: The first aircraft should begin two-hour preparation at 23.5 and the second at 24.0, leaving one of two crew busy for the initial half-hour and both busy afterward. Under MAXUT=1, the two-crew pool has two crew-hours in the first shift, provisionally reached at 24.75 (0.5 hour with one worker plus 0.75 hour with two). The limit may stop active work; the native event sequence must establish the actual rule, remaining times, second-shift reset and mission outcomes. The unlimited pair is a control for shift and scheduling effects. No behavior is accepted before native event and ledger replay.
